# Audio Outcome and Control Requirements Checklist: Synthesized Audio Feedback

**Purpose**: Review the requirements quality of gameplay outcome classification and optional synthesized-audio control
**Created**: 2026-08-17
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. Implementation completion is recorded separately in `tasks.md` and `verification.md`.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are the three distinct audible outcomes and their relative duration and secondary-feedback constraints stated for gameplay results? [Spec §FR-001, §Initial Audio Palette]
- [x] CHK002 Does the requirement coverage explicitly include both the player's fleet board and the visible target board for pushed and refetched full gameplay states? [Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK003 Are baseline, duplicate, moat, visibility-only, and batched real-shot conditions covered as distinct classification cases? [Spec §FR-003–FR-008]
- [x] CHK004 Are default enablement, persistence, gesture unlocking, disabled operation, unavailable audio, and cleanup behavior all specified? [Spec §FR-009–FR-012]
- [x] CHK005 Are preservation requirements for visual feedback, toasts, transport, navigation, and the backend/API boundary explicit? [Spec §FR-013–FR-015, §Contract and Boundary Requirements]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK006 Is a genuinely newly shot cell defined unambiguously by the relevant `hasShot` transition rather than by visibility or any other state change? [Spec §FR-003–FR-004, Data Model §FleetBoardDiff]
- [x] CHK007 Is fleet-board `DESTROYED` classification tied to a ship newly becoming complete, rather than to a ship that was already sunk in the baseline? [Spec §FR-005, Data Model §FleetBoardDiff]
- [x] CHK008 Is target-board `DESTROYED` classification tied to the alive-ship-count decrease in the same transition and to the corresponding newly shot candidate? [Spec §FR-006, §FR-008, Data Model §TargetBoardDiff]
- [x] CHK009 Is the distinction between a partially revealed target-board `HIT` and a destroyed ship stated without relying on hidden ship details? [Spec §FR-006, User Story 2]
- [x] CHK010 Are “subtle,” “conservative level,” and the approximate recipe durations and frequency ranges constrained enough for an objective requirements review? [Spec §FR-001, §Initial Audio Palette, §SC-002]
- [x] CHK011 Are “explicit user gesture,” “silent unlock,” and “best-effort no-op” defined in observable terms for supported and blocked browser audio? [Spec §FR-011–FR-012, Contract §AudioFeedbackPort]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK012 Do the specification, data model, contract, and plan agree that the classifier consumes the full gameplay snapshot and has no browser or audio dependencies? [Spec §FR-002, Frontend Requirements; Contract §Outcome and event types; Plan §Contract and Data Flow Plan]
- [x] CHK013 Do the baseline rules agree about first-snapshot seeding, duplicate replacement, and a remount starting a fresh baseline without replaying its initial state? [Spec §FR-003–FR-004; Data Model §GameplaySnapshotBaseline]
- [x] CHK014 Are default-enabled preference behavior and no audible output before the first gesture expressed consistently? [Spec §FR-010–FR-011; Contract §AudioFeedbackPort]
- [x] CHK015 Are the prohibition on direct `handleShot` playback and the requirement to classify local and incoming state through one path consistent? [Spec §FR-013; Plan §Structure Decision and §Implementation Phases]
- [x] CHK016 Are the exclusions for preparation, waiting-room, results, and final-state visibility-only changes consistent across scope, scenarios, edge cases, and plan? [Spec §Out of Scope; §FR-007, §FR-015; Plan §Structure Decision]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK017 Can SC-001 objectively distinguish one event per real shot from zero events for baseline, duplicate, visibility-only, and moat cases on both boards? [Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK018 Does SC-002 identify observable recipe evidence while leaving the synthesis node graph and exact tunable constants appropriately unconstrained? [Spec §SC-002, §FR-014; Contract §Recipe contract]
- [x] CHK019 Does SC-003 measure default state, localized pressed state, disabled playback, reload persistence, and independence from game cleanup? [Spec §SC-003]
- [x] CHK020 Does SC-004 make English/Ukrainian parity cover on/off labels as well as accessibility, unlock, and failure text? [Spec §SC-004, Frontend Requirements]
- [x] CHK021 Does SC-005 distinguish audio failures and rapid lifecycle changes from regressions in rendering, toasts, tabs, and navigation? [Spec §SC-005]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK022 Are independent primary scenarios defined for MISS, HIT, and DESTROYED outcomes on both gameplay boards? [Spec §User Story 1, Acceptance Scenarios 1–4]
- [x] CHK023 Are independent alternate scenarios defined for an initial populated snapshot, an equivalent duplicate snapshot, a target visibility-only change, and a fleet moat reveal? [Spec §User Story 2, Acceptance Scenarios 1–3]
- [x] CHK024 Are batched real shots and a target-board alive-ship decrease represented without allowing automatic reveals to collapse or multiply real outcomes? [Spec §User Story 2, Acceptance Scenarios 4–6]
- [x] CHK025 Are disabled, not-yet-unlocked, unsupported, suspended, rejected, and interrupted audio scenarios covered without making gameplay depend on sound availability? [Spec §User Story 3, §Edge Cases, §FR-011–FR-012]
- [x] CHK026 Are English, Ukrainian, keyboard operation, visible state, and localized on/off labels represented as a complete control scenario? [Spec §User Story 3, Acceptance Scenario 4; §FR-009]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK027 Is the difference between a first baseline containing old shots and a later equivalent duplicate state explicit enough to prevent replay after refresh or remount? [Spec §Edge Cases; Data Model §GameplaySnapshotBaseline]
- [x] CHK028 Is the simultaneous-change case clear when real newly shot cells and automatically revealed moat cells appear in one state transition? [Spec §FR-007–FR-008, §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK029 Is the target-board case with multiple newly visible ship-bearing candidates and one alive-ship decrease resolved or explicitly constrained? [Spec §FR-006, §FR-008; Data Model §TargetBoardDiff]
- [x] CHK030 Are rapid state updates, screen unmount, scheduled sound cleanup, and rejected asynchronous audio operations bounded by explicit safe outcomes? [Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-012; Contract §AudioFeedbackPort]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK031 Is the expectation that classification and playback requests do not block rendering or network state application stated with an acceptance-observable bound? [Spec §FR-012, §SC-005; Plan §Performance Goals]
- [x] CHK032 Are keyboard reachability, `aria-pressed` semantics, visible enabled/disabled state, and accessible labels complete for the Sound control? [Spec §FR-009; Contract §Gameplay UI contract]
- [x] CHK033 Are localization parity and the required accessible, loading, unlock, and failure text defined without leaving one locale behaviorally incomplete? [Spec §Frontend Requirements, §SC-004]
- [x] CHK034 Are browser capability, autoplay-policy, output-device, visibility, and no-unhandled-rejection expectations stated without depending on a real speaker? [Spec §FR-011–FR-012, §SC-005; Plan §Complexity and Risk Factors]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK035 Are the assumptions about existing full-state transport, browser audio capability, and user-gesture policy explicit enough to identify what is guaranteed versus best effort? [Spec §Assumptions and Clarifications]
- [x] CHK036 Is storage failure or unavailability for the independent sound preference addressed, or explicitly recorded as a deferred product decision? [Spec §FR-010, §FR-012, §Assumptions and Clarifications]
- [x] CHK037 Are the absence of new backend/API/DTO/OpenAPI, external-service, audio-file, and runtime-library dependencies stated as a complete boundary? [Spec §FR-014, §Contract and Boundary Requirements; Plan §Constraints]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [x] CHK038 Is “newly observed” aligned between the `hasShot` transition, equivalent-snapshot rule, and the audio-port event contract so that no two definitions can produce different event counts? [Spec §FR-003–FR-004; Contract §Outcome and event types]
- [x] CHK039 Is the target-board relationship between an alive-ship-count decrease and the cell marked `DESTROYED` explicit for normal server transitions and any non-normal multi-cell transition? [Spec §FR-006, §FR-008; Data Model §TargetBoardDiff]
- [x] CHK040 Is the meaning of preference persistence across reload, leaving a game, game-session cleanup, and browser-profile boundaries consistent enough to avoid conflicting storage expectations? [Spec §FR-010; Data Model §SoundPreference]

## Notes

- This checklist is intentionally separate from `checklists/requirements.md`, which has its own built-in lifecycle.
- All requirements-quality items are reviewed and marked `[x]`; implementation completion is recorded in `tasks.md` and `verification.md`.
- The checklist focuses on state classification/deduplication and optional audio control, accessibility, and failure boundaries.
